messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary rollout 'staggered-wave-5' (us-west-2) - elevated 5xx + failing healthchecks. Abort criteria met (>=10% 5xx over 5m). Follow canary kill-switch runbook.
alex: seeing 5xx spike on /v1/generate. p95 latency up. Link: https://grafana.redwood/c/Canary-Health
maria: prober khz-prober-1 returning 503s to /healthz, multiple hosts
alex: quick logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T22:40:05Z] host=canary-12 /v1/generate 503 "kv-cache-miss" x 37
[2026-03-17T22:40:12Z] host=canary-14 /v1/generate 502 "oom-retry" x 12
```
eric: paging @sre-liz — if abort criteria still true I'll flip the rollout flag. Can someone confirm customer impact first?
pm-jordan: how many customers affected? any enterprise tenants showing errors?
support-bot: 3 customers reporting errors via support portal: acct-172, acct-55, acct-data-ops. No P1 escalations yet.
eric: running kill-switch command now: `./ops/flags/toggle.sh canary.staggered_wave_5 pause --reason "healthcheck-fail-5xx"`
deploy-bot: Flag canary.staggered_wave_5 set to PAUSE by eric at 2026-03-17T22:41:10Z
maria: pause first, don't rollback whole model pool until we confirm root cause. pause should stop traffic steering for the wave.
alex: agree — pause, then revert model variant only if we see config regression.
sre-liz: taking over oncall. I'll validate rollback not needed immediately and run traffic dump + KV cache check.
sre-liz: quick metrics: overall 5xx 3.2%, us-west-2 12.7%, p50=200ms p95=2.3s. Spike correlates with probe timeout increases.
eric: note for postmortem: rollout-id=staggered-wave-5, action=flag-pause. Monitoring for 10m, will escalate if >5% 5xx persists.
pm-jordan: customer comms: ask CS to post a short status update. ETA to next update 30m.
support-bot: CS notified. Draft status sent to #customer-updates for review.
sre-liz: handover: I'll own until 23:30 UTC. Runbook ref: `runbook/canary-abort.md` steps: 1) confirm flag=PAUSE 2) check kv-cache pressure 3) consider replica scale or model-variant revert 4) prepare rollback if >2x baseline 5) notify customers.
eric: thanks liz — leaving handoff now. :white_check_mark:
maria: tagging postmortem: `postmortems/stags-wave5` and suspected area: health-probe-threshold tuning.
pm-jordan: thx team, please keep updates in this thread for CS + eng sync.
